description.short: Application security analysis via Claude AI agents
description.full: threatlint offers specialized application security agents powered by Claude AI: threat modeling, code review, supply chain, compliance, runtime evidence, business logic, client security, cryptography, AI/LLM security, security test planning, secure code generation, and privacy review. Teams analyzes supplied redacted evidence only; it cannot inspect repositories, capture traffic, log in, or execute tests.
